parsed.final_position: Adopt the draft only as a provisional multi-label taxonomy after validating all needs-review records and refining ambiguous mappings, while retaining original labels and adding a manually coded primary-family variable for mutually exclusive tabulation.
parsed.reasoning: I agree that the 45% multiple rate exposes mapping rules that should be examined and that all 45 needs-review studies require validation before implementation. However, refining keywords merely to force studies into one family risks concealing genuine multi-mechanism designs; the multiple rate may reflect both rule overbreadth and real conceptual overlap. Therefore, rule refinement should improve mapping validity, while a separately and manually coded primary family—not mechanical keyword tie-breaking—should support headline tabulation.
